candidates.change_summary: Remove the owner check so anyone can call sendTo, changing which calls succeed and thus observable state/transfer outcomes.
Change the zero-address check to allow address(0), which can alter observable transfers by enabling sending to address(0).
Change the amount check to allow zero amounts, which can change observable state (no transfer) when amount is zero.
Reverse the owner check to require the caller is not the owner, changing which callers can invoke transfers.
